## Summary

Created `src/test/org/apache/commons/lang/text/StrBuilderAgentTest.java` with 160 JUnit 3.8-style test methods covering constructors, capacity management, char/array access, all `append`/`insert`/`delete`/`replace` overloads, `reverse`/`trim`, `startsWith`/`endsWith`, substring extraction, `contains`/`indexOf`/`lastIndexOf`, the reader/writer/tokenizer views, and `equals`/`hashCode`/`toString`.

7 tests fail, each showing a real bug in `StrBuilder`:

1. **`testIndexOfCharIgnoresDataBeyondLogicalSize`** — `indexOf(char, int)` loops to `buffer.length` (physical capacity) instead of `size` (logical length), so stale characters left behind after `setLength()` shrinks the builder are found and returned as valid indices.
2. **`testIndexOfStringIgnoresDataBeyondLogicalSize`** — `indexOf(String, int)` has the same bug: its search bound is derived from `buffer.length` instead of `size`.
3. **`testContainsCharIgnoresDataBeyondLogicalSize`** — `contains(char)` iterates over `buffer.length` instead of `size`, same root cause.
4. **`testEqualsStrBuilderNullReturnsFalse`** — the javadoc for `equals(StrBuilder)` says "null returns false", but the method dereferences `other.size` without a null check, throwing `NullPointerException`.
5. **`testEqualsIgnoreCaseNullReturnsFalse`** — same issue in `equalsIgnoreCase(StrBuilder)`.
6. **`testAppendFixedWidthPadLeftNullObjectUsesNullText`** — when `obj` is `null` and the default `nullText` is also `null` (the documented default "append nothing"), `appendFixedWidthPadLeft` calls `.length()` on that `null` string, throwing `NullPointerException` instead of treating it as empty text.
7. **`testAppendFixedWidthPadRightNullObjectUsesNullText`** — identical bug in `appendFixedWidthPadRight`.
